Aey Nabi, badwi (bedouns) arabon mein se jo log pichey chodh diye gaye thay ab woh aa kar zaroor tumse kahenge ke humein apne amwal aur baal bacchon ki fikr ne mashgul kar rakkha tha. Aap hamare liye magfirat ki dua famayein. Yeh log apni zubaano se woh baatein kehte hain jo unke dilon mein nahin hoti. Unse kehna “acha, yahi baat hai to kaun tumhare maamle mein Allah ke faisle ko rok dene ka kuch bhi ikhtiyar rakhta hai agar woh tumhein koi nuksan pahunchana chahey ya nafa bakshna chahe? Tumhare aamal se to Allah hi ba-khabar hai

[48:12]

(Magar asal baat woh nahin hai jo tum keh rahey ho) balke tumne yun samjha ke Rasool aur mominin apne ghar walon mein hargiz palat kar na aa sakenge aur yeh khayal tumhare dilon ko bahut bhala laga. Aur tumne bahut burey guman kiye aur tum sakht badh batin (immensely evil) log ho”

[48:13]

Allah aur uske Rasool par jo log imaan na rakhte hon aisey kaafiron ke liye humne bhadakti aag muhaiyya kar rakkhi hai

[48:14]

Aasmano aur zameen ki badshahi ka maalik Allah hi hai. Jisey chahe maaf karey aur jisey chahe saza de. Aur woh Gafoor o Raheem hai

[48:15]

Jab tum maal-e-ganimat hasil karne ke liye jane lagoge to yeh pichey chodey jane waley log tumse zaroor kahenge ke humein bhi apne saath chalne do. Yeh chahte hain ke Allah ke farmaan ko badal dein. Inse saaf keh dena ke “Tum hargiz hamare saath nahin chal sakte. Allah pehle hi yeh farma chuka hai” yeh kahenge ke “nahin, balke tumlog humse hasad kar rahey ho” (halanke baat hasad ki nahin hai) balke yeh log sahih baat ko kam hi samajhte hain

[48:16]

In pichey chodey janey waley badwi(bedouin) arabon se kehna ke “ankareeb tumhein aisey logon se ladne ke liye bulaya jayega jo badey zoarawar hain. Tumko unse jung karni hogi ya woh mutii (surrender) ho jayenge. Us waqt agar tumne hukum e jihad ki itaat ki to Allah tumhein accha ajar dega. Aur agar tum phir usi tarah mooh moad gaye jis tarah pehle moad chuke ho to Allah tumko dardnaak saza dega

[48:17]

Agar andha aur langda aur mareez jihad ke liye na aaye to koi haraj nahin. Jo koi Allah aur uske Rasool ki itaat karega Allah usey un jannaton mein dakhil karega jinke nichey nehrein beh rahi hongi, aur jo mooh pherega usey woh dardnaak azaab dega”

[48:18]

Allah momino se khush ho gaya jab woh darakht ke nichey tumse bayt (swore allegiance) kar rahey thay. Unke dilon ka haal usko maloom tha. Is liye usne unpar sakinat(inner peace) nazil farmayi, unko inaam mein qareebi fatah bakshi

[48:19]

Aur bahut sa maal-e-ganimat unhein ata kar diya jisey woh (anqareeb) hasil karenge. Allah zabardast aur hakeem(wise) hai

[48:20]

Allah tumse ba-kasrat amwal-e-ganimat ka wada karta hai jinhein tum hasil karoge. Fauri taur par to yeh fatah usne tumhein ata kardi aur logon ke haath tumhare khilaf uthne se roak diye, taa-ke yeh momino ke liye ek nishani ban jaye aur Allah seedhe raaste ki taraf tumhein hidayat bakshe

[48:21]

Iske alawa dusre aur ganimaton ka bhi woh tumse waada karta hai jinpar tum abhi tak qadir nahin huey ho aur Allah ne inko gher rakkha hai, Allah har cheez par qadir hai

[48:22]

Yeh kafir log agar is waqt tumse ladd gaye hotey to yaqeenan peeth pher jaatey aur koi haami o madadgaar na paate

[48:23]

Yeh Allah ki sunnat hai jo pehle se chali aa rahi hai aur tum Allah ki sunnat mein koi tabdili na paogey

[48:24]

Wahi hai jisne Makkah ki wadi mein unke haath tumse aur tumhare haath unse roak diye, halanke woh unpar tumhein galaba ata kar chuka tha aur jo kuch tum kar rahey thay Allah usey dekh raha tha

[48:25]

Whai log to hain jinhon ne kufr kiya aur tumko masjid e haram se roka aur haadi(qurbani) ke Unton (camels) ko unki qurbani ki jagah na pahunchne diya. Agar (Makkah mein) aisey momin Mard o aurat maujood na hotay jinhein tum nahin jante, aur yeh khatra na hota ke nadanastagi mein tum unhein pamaal kardoge aur ussey tumpar haraf aayega (to jung na roaki jati. roaki woh is liye gayi) taa-ke Allah apni rehmat mein jisko chahe daakhil karle. Woh momin alag ho gaye hotey to (ehle Makkah mein se) jo kafir thay unko hum zaroor sakht saza dete

[48:26]

(Yahi wajah hai ke) jab in kafiron ne apne dilon mei jaahilana hamiyat bitha li to Allah ne apne Rasool aur momino par sakinat nazil farmayi aur momino ko taqwa ki baat ka paband rakkha, ke wahi uske zyada haqdar aur uske ahel thay. Allah har cheez ka ilm rakhta hai

[48:27]

Fil waqeh Allah ne apne Rasool ko saccha khwab dikhaya tha jo theek theek haqq ke mutabiq tha. Insha Allah tum zaroor masjid e haram mein purey aman ke saath dakhil hongey, apne sar mundwa-ogey (shave) aur baal tarashwa-ogey aur tumhein koi khauff na hoga. Woh us baat ko janta tha jisey tum na jante thay is liye woh khwab pura honay se pehle usne yeh qareebi fatah tumko ata farmadi

[48:28]

Woh Allah hi hai jisne apne Rasool ko hidayat aur deen e haqq ke saath bheja hai taa-ke usko purey jins-e-din par gaalib karde (prevail over every religion) aur is haqeeqat par Allah ki gawahi kaafi hai

[48:29]

Muhammad Allah ke Rasool hain, aur jo log unke saath hain woh kuffar par sakht aur aapas mein raheem hain. Tum jab dekhoge unhein ruku va sujood aur Allah ke fazl aur uski khushnudi ki talab mein mashgul paogey. Sujood ke asarat unke chehron par maujood hain jinse woh alag pehchane jatey hain. Yeh hai unki sifat Taurat mein. Aur Injeel mein unki misal yun di gayi hai ke goya ek kheti hai jisne pehle kopal nikali, phir us ko taqviyat di, phir woh gadhrayi, phir apne tanay (stem) par khadi ho gayi. Kaasht (sowers) karne walon ko woh khush karti hai taa-ke kuffar inke phalne phoolne par jalein (enraged). Is giroh ke log jo imaan laye hain aur jinhon ne neik amal kiye hain Allah ne unse magfirat aur bade ajar ka waada farmaya hai

Surah 049: Al-Hujurat (The Apartments)

[49:1]

Aey logon jo imaan laye ho, Allah aur uske Rasool ke aagey pesh qadmi na karo aur Allah se daro, Allah sab kuch sunne aur jaanne wala hai

[49:2]

Aey logon jo imaan laaye ho, apni aawaz Nabi ki awaaz se buland na karo, aur na Nabi ke saath unchi aawaz se baat kiya karo jis tarah tum aapas mein ek dusre se karte ho, kahin aisa na ho ke tumhara kiya karaya sab gharat ho jaye( deeds become vain) aur tumhein khabar bhi na ho

[49:3]

Jo log Rasool-e-khuda ke huzoor baat karte huey apni aawaz pastt rakhte hain woh dar haqeeqat wahi log hai jinke dilon ko Allah ne takwa ke liye jaanch liya hai. Unke liye magfirat hai aur ajr-e- azeem

[49:4]

Aey Nabi, jo log tumhein hujron(apartments) ke bahar se pukarte hain unmein se aksar be-aqal hain

[49:5]

Agar woh tumhare baramad honay tak sabr karte to unhi ke liye behtar tha, Allah darguzar karne wala aur Raheem hai

[49:6]

Aey logon jo imaan laaye ho, agar koi faasiq tumhare paas koi khabar lekar aaye to tehqeek kar liya karo, kahin aisa na ho ke tum kisi giroh ko nadanishta(unwittingly) nuksaan pahuncha baitho aur phir apne kiye par pashemaan ho

[49:7]

Khoob jaan rakkho ke tumhare darmiyaan Allah ka Rasool maujood hai. Agar woh bahut se maamelaat mein tumhari baat maan liya kare, to tum khud hi mushkilaat mein mubtala ho jao. Magar Allah ne tumko imaan ki muhabbat di aur usko tumhare liye dil pasand bana diya, aur kufr-o-fusuk aur nafarmani se tumko mutanaffir(abhorrent) kar diya

[49:8]

Aisey hi log Allah ke fazal o ehsaan se raast-ro hain aur Allah Aleem-o-Hakeem(All-Knowing, All-Wise) hai

[49:9]

Aur agar ehle imaan mein se do giroh aapas mein ladh jayein, to unke darmiyan sulah (peace) karao. Phir agar unmein se ek giroh dusre giroh se zyadati karey, to zyadati karne wale se ladho yahan tak ke woh Allah ke hukum ki taraf palat aaye. Phir agar woh palat aaye, to unke darmiyan adal ke saath sulah kara do, aur insaaf karo ke Allah insaaf karne walon ko pasand karta hai

[49:10]

Momin to ek dusre ke bhai hain, lihaza apne bhaiyon ke darmiyaan taaluqat ko durust karo aur Allah se daro, umeed hai ke tumpar reham kiya jayega

[49:11]

Aey logon jo imaan laye ho, na mard dusre mardon ka mazaak udayein, ho sakta hai ke woh unse behtar hon, aur na auratein dusri auraton ka mazaak udayein, ho sakta hai ke woh unse behtar hon. Aapas mein ek dusre par taan na karo, aur na ek dusre ko burey alaqab (titles) se yaad karo. Imaan lane ke baad fisq mein naam paida karna bahut buri baat hai. Jo log is rawish se baaz na aayein wahi zalim hain

[49:12]

Aey logon jo imaan laaye ho, bahut gumaan (suspicion)karne se parheiz karo ke baaz gumaan (suspicion) gunaah hote hain. Tajassus (jasusi) na karo aur tum mein se koi kisi ki geebat na karey. kya tumhare andar koi aisa hai jo apne marey(dead) huey bhai ka gosht khana pasand karega? Dekho, tum khud is se gheen khate ho. Allah se daro, Allah bada tawbah qabool karne wala aur Raheem hai

[49:13]

Logon, humne tumko ek Mard aur ek Aurat se paida kiya aur phir tumhari qaumein aur biradariyan bana di taa-ke tum ek dusre ko pehchano. Dar haqeeqat Allah ke nazdeek tum mein sab se zyada izzat wala woh hai jo tumhare andar sab se zyada parheizgaar hai. Yaqeenan Allah sab kuch jaan-ne wala aur baakhabar hai

[49:14]

Yeh badwi (Bedouins) kehte hain ke “hum imaan laye” insey kaho: “tum imaan nahin laye, balke yun kaho ke hum muti (submissive) ho gaye” imaan abhi tumhare dilon mein daakhil nahin hua hai. Agar tum Allah aur uske Rasool ki farmabardari ikhtiyar karlo to woh tumhare amal ke ajr mein koi kami na karega.Yakeenan Allah bada darguzar karne wala aur Raheem hai

[49:15]

Haqeeqat mein to momin woh hain jo Allah aur uske Rasool par imaan laye phir unhon ne koi shakk na kiya aur apne jaano aur maalon se Allah ki raah mein jihad kiya, wahi sacchey log hain

[49:16]

Aey Nabi, In [mudaiyaan e imaan (pretenders to faith)] se kaho, kya tum Allah ko apne deen ki ittilah (apprising) de rahey ho? Halanke Allah zameen aur Aasmano ki har cheez ko jaanta hai aur woh har shay ka ilm rakhta hai

[49:17]

Yeh log tumpar ehsan jatate hain ke inhon ne Islam qabool karliya. Inse kaho apne Islam ka ehsan mujhpar na rakkho , balke Allah tumpar apna ehsan rakhta hai ke usne tumhein imaan ki hidayat di agar tum waqai apne daawa-e-imaan mein sacchey ho

[49:18]

Allah zameen aur aasmano ki har poshida(hidden) cheez ka ilm rakhta hai aur jo kuch tum karte ho woh sab uski nigaah mein hai

Surah 050: Qaf (Qaf)

[50:1]

Qaaf, Kasam hai quran-e-majeed ki

[50:2]

Balke in logon ko taajub is baat par hua ke ek khabardar karne wala khud inhi mein se inke paas aa gaya, phir munkireen kehne lagey “yeh to ajeeb baat hai

[50:3]

Kya jab hum mar jayenge aur khaak (mitti) ho jayenge (to dobara uthaye jayenge)? Yeh wapasi to aqal se baeed hai”

[50:4]

Zameen inke jism mein se jo kuch khati hai woh sab hamare ilm mein hai aur hamare paas ek kitaab hai jismein sab kuch mehfooz hai

[50:5]

Balke in logon ne to jis waqt haqq inke paas aaya usi waqt usey saaf jhutla diya. Isi wajah se ab yeh uljhan mein padey huey hain

[50:6]

Accha, to kya inhon ne kabhi apne upar aasmaan ki taraf nahin dekha? Kis tarah humne usey banaya aur aarasta (zeenat/ beautify) kiya, aur usmein kahin koi rakhna(cracks/rifts) nahin hai

[50:7]

Aur zameen ko humne bichaya aur ismein pahadh jamaye aur uske andar har taraah ki khush manzar nabataat uga di

[50:8]

Yeh saari cheezein aankhein kholne wali aur sabaq dene wali hain har us bandey ke liye jo (haqq ki taraf) rujoo karne wala ho

[50:9]

Aur aasmaan se humne barkat wala paani naazil kiya,phir ussey baagh aur fasal ke galley

[50:10]

Aur buland o baala khajoor ke darakht paida kardiye jinpar phalon(fruits) se ladey khoshey teh-bar-teh lagte (fruit arranged in layers) hain

[50:11]

Yeh intizaam hai bandon ko rizq dene ka is pani se hum ek murda zameen ko zindagi baksh dete hain (marey huey Insano ka zameen se) nikalne bhi isi tarah hoga

[50:12]

In se pehle Nooh ki qaum, aur ashab-ur-rass ,aur Samood

[50:13]

Aur Aad, aur Firoun , aur Lut ke bhai

[50:14]

Aur aykah( dwellers in the wood) wale, aur tubba ki qaum ke log bhi jhutla chuke hain har ek ne Rasoolon ko jhutlaya , aur aakhir e kaar meri waeed(threat) un par chaspan ho gayi

[50:15]

Kya pehli baar ki takhleeq(creation) se hum aajiz (worn out) thay? Magar ek nayi takhleeq ki taraf se yeh log shakk mein padey huey hain

[50:16]

Humne Insaan ko paida kiya hai aur uske dil mein ubharne wale waswason tak ko hum jaante hain. Hum to us ki rag-e-gardan(jugular vein) se bhi zyada us se qareeb hain

[50:17]

(aur hamare is barah-e-raast ilm ke alawa)do kaatib(scribes) uske dayein aur bayein baithay(farishtey) har cheez sabt(likh) kar rahe hain

[50:18]

Koi lafz us ki zubaan se nahin nikalta jisey mehfooz karne ke liye ek hazir baash nigraan maujood na ho

[50:19]

Phir dekho, woh maut ki jaan-kani (agony of death) haqq lekar aa pahunchi, yeh wahi cheez hai jisse tu bhaaghta tha

[50:20]

Aur phir sur (trumpet) phoonka gaya, yeh hai woh din jiska tujhe khauf dilaya jata tha

[50:21]

Har shaks is haal mein aa gaya ke uske saath ek haank(drive) kar lane wala hai aur ek gawahi dene wala

[50:22]

Is cheez ki taraf se tu gaflat mein tha, humne woh purda hata diya jo tere aagey pada hua tha aur aaj teri nigaah khoob tez hai

[50:23]

Uske saathi ne arz kiya ye jo meri supurdgi mein tha haazir hai

[50:24]

Hukum diya gaya “phenk do jahannum mein har katte (hardened, stubborn) kaafir ko jo haqq se inaad rakhta tha

[50:25]

Khair ko roakne wala aur hadd se tajauz (exceeds the limits) karne wala tha, shakk mein pada hua tha

[50:26]

Aur Allah ke saath kisi dusre ko khuda banaye baitha tha. Daal do usey sakht azaab mein”

[50:27]

Uske saathi ne arz kiya “khuda-wanda, maine isko sarkash nahin banaya balke yeh khud hi parle darje ki gumrahi mein pada hua tha”

[50:28]

Jawab mein irshad hua “mere huzoor jhagda na karo, main tumko pehle hi anjaam-e-badd se khabardar kar chuka tha

[50:29]

Mere haan (yahan) baat palti nahin jaati aur main apne bandon par zulm todhne wala nahin hoon”

[50:30]

Woh din jabke hum jahannum se puchenge kya tu bhar gayi? Aur woh kahegi kya aur kuch hai

[50:31]

Aur Jannat muttaqin ke qareeb le aayi jayegi, kuch bhi dur na hogi

[50:32]

Irshad hoga “yeh hai woh cheez jiska tumse waada kiya jata tha, har us shaks ke liye jo bahut rujoo karne wala aur badi nigehdaasht (watchful of his conduct) karne wala tha

[50:33]

Jo bay dekhe Rehman se darta tha, aur jo dil-e-girwida liye huey aaya hai

[50:34]

Dakhil ho jao Jannat mein salamati ke saath” woh din hayat-e-abadi (eternity) ka din hoga

[50:35]

Wahan unke liye woh sab kuch hoga jo woh chahenge, aur hamare paas issey zyada bhi bahut kuch unke liye hai

[50:36]

Hum unse pehle bahut si qaumon ko halaak kar chuke hain jo insey bahut zyada taaqatwar thi aur duniya ke mulkon ko unhon ne chaan maara tha phir kya woh koi jaaye panaah paa sakey

[50:37]

Is tareekh mein ibrat ka sabaq hai har us shaks ke liye jo dil rakhta ho, ya jo tawajju se baat ko suney

[50:38]

Humne zameen aur aasmaano ko aur unke darmiyan ki saari cheezon ko chey(six) dino mein paida kardiya aur humein koi thakaan laahiq na hui

[50:39]

Pas aey Nabi, jo baatein yeh log banate hain unpar sabr karo, aur apne Rubb ki hamd ke saath uski tasbeeh karte raho, tulu-e-aftaab( rising of the sun ) aur guroob-e-aftaab( before its setting ) se pehle

[50:40]

Aur raat ke waqt phir uski tasbeeh karo aur sajda reizion se faarig honay ke baad bhi(wake of prostration)

[50:41]

Aur suno, jis din munadi (pukaar) karne wala (har shaks ke)qareeb hi se pukarega

[50:42]

Jis din sab log aawaza-e-hashar ko theek theek sun rahey honge, woh zameen se murdon ke nikalne ka din hoga

[50:43]

Hum hi zindagi bakshte hain aur hum hi maut detey hain, aur hamari hi taraf us din sabko palatna hai

[50:44]

Jab zameen phategi log uske andar se nikal kar teiz teiz bhage ja rahe honge. Yeh hashar hamare liye bahut aasaan hai

[50:45]

Aey Nabi, jo baatein yeh log bana rahe hain unhein hum khoob jaante hain, aur tumhara kaam inse jabran (zabardasti) baat manwana nahin hai. Bas tum is Quran ke zariye se har us shaks ko nasihat kardo jo meri tambeeh se darey

Surah 051: Ad-Dhariyat (The Scatterers)

[51:1]

Kasam hai un hawaon ki jo gard (dust) udane wali hain

[51:2]

Phir pani se ladeh huey badal uthane wali hain

[51:3]

Phir subuk raftari (smoothly speed along) ke saath chalne wali hain

[51:4]

Phir ek baday kaam (barish) ki taqseem karne wali hain

[51:5]

Haqq yeh hai ke jis cheez ka tumhein khauf dilaya ja raha hai woh sacchi hai

[51:6]

Aur jazaa-e-aamal (recompense) zaroor pesh aani hai

[51:7]

Kasam hai muttafarriq shakalon(numerous forms) waley aasmaan ki

[51:8]

(Aakhirat ke barey mein) tumhari baat ek durse se mukhtalif hai

[51:9]

Ussey wahi bargashta (deluded/averse) hota hai jo haqq se phira hua hai

[51:10]

Maarey gaye qayas-o-gumaan (conjecturers) se hukum lagane wale

[51:11]

Jo jihalat(ignorance) mein garq aur gaflat mein madhosh hain

[51:12]

Puchte hain aakhir woh roz-e-jaza kab aayega

[51:13]

Woh us roz aayega jab yeh log aag par tapaye jayenge

[51:14]

(Insey kaha jayega) ab chakkho maza apne fitne ka, yeh wahi cheez hai jiske liye tum jaldi macha rahey thay

[51:15]

Albatta muttaqi log us roz baaghon(gardens) aur chashmo (fountains) mein hongey

[51:16]

Jo kuch unka Rubb unhein dega usey khushi khushi le rahey hongey. Woh us din ke aane se pehle neikukar (doers of good) thay

[51:17]

Raaton(nights) ko kam hi sotey(sleep) thay

[51:18]

Phir wahi raat ke pichle peharon mein maafi maangte thay

[51:19]

Aur unke maalon(wealth) mein haqq tha saahil( maangne waley) aur mehroom(destitute) ke liye

[51:20]

Zameen mein bahut si nishaniyan hain yaqeen laney walon ke liye

[51:21]

Aur khud tumhare apne wajood mein hain, kya tumko soojhta nahin

[51:22]

Aasman hi mein hai tumhara rizq bhi aur woh cheez bhi jiska tumse waada kiya ja raha hai

[51:23]

Pas kasam hai aasmaan aur zameen ke maalik ki, yeh baat haqq hai, aisi hi yaqeeni jaise tum bol rahey ho

[51:24]

Aey Nabi, Ibrahim ke muazzaz mehmano ki hiqayat bhi tumhein pahunchi hai

[51:25]

Jab woh uske haan (yahan) aaye to kaha aapko salaam hai. Usne kaha “ aap logon ko bhi salaam hai kuch na-aashna se log hain”

[51:26]

Phir woh chupke se apne ghar walon ke paas gaya, aur ek mota taaza bachda (calf) laa kar

[51:27]

Mehmanon ke aage pesh kiya. Usne kaha aap hazraat khate nahin

[51:28]

Phir woh apne dil mein unse dara. Unhon ne kaha dariye nahin, aur usey ek zee-ilm ladke ki paidaish ka mushda (good news/basharat) sunaya

[51:29]

Yeh sunkar uski biwi cheekhti hui aage badhi aur usne apna mooh peeth liya aur kehne lagi, “boodhi baanj”

[51:30]

Unhon ne kaha “yahi kuch farmaya hai tere Rubb ne. Woh hakeem hai aur sab kuch jaanta hai

[51:31]

Ibrahim ne kaha “aey farstaadgaan-e-ilaahi (envoys), kya mohim aapko dar-pesh hai

[51:32]

Unhon ne kaha “hum ek mujrim qaum ki taraf bheje gaye hain

[51:33]

Taa-ke uspar paki hui mitti ke patthar (clay-stones) barsa de

[51:34]

Jo aapke Rubb ke haan hadd se guzar jane walon ke liye nishan zada hain”

[51:35]

Phir humne un sab logon ko nikal liya jo us basti mein momin thay

[51:36]

Aur wahan humne ek ghar ke siwa musalmano ka koi ghar na paya

[51:37]

Uske baad humne wahan bas ek nishani un logon ke liye chodh di jo dardnaak azaab se darte hon

[51:38]

Aur (tumhare liye nishani hai) Moosa ke qissey mein jab humne usey sareeh sanad (clear authority) ke saath Firoun ke paas bheja

[51:39]

To woh apne bal-bootay par akad gaya aur bola yeh jaadugar hai ya majnoon(deewana) hai

[51:40]

Aakhir-e-kaar humne usey aur uske lashkaron ko pakda aur sabko samandar mein phenk diya aur woh malamat zadah hokar reh gaya

[51:41]

Aur (tumhare liye nishani hai) Aad (people of Aad) mein, jabke humne unpar ek aisi hi bay-khair(devastating) hawa bhej di

[51:42]

Ke jis cheez par bhi woh guzar gayi usey boseeda (rotten) karke rakh diya

[51:43]

Aur (tumhare liye nishani hai) Samood mein, jab unse kaha gaya tha ke ek khaas waqt tak mazey karlo

[51:44]

Magar is tambeeh(warning) par bhi unhon ne apne Rubb ke hukum se sartabi (brazenly disobey) ki. Aakhir-e-kar unke dekhte dekhte ek achanak toot padne waley azaab ne unko aa liya

[51:45]

Phir na unmein uthne ki sakat thi aur na woh apna bachao kar sakte thay

[51:46]

Aur in sabse pehle humne Nooh ki qaum ko halaak kiya kyunke woh fasiq (wicked) log thay

[51:47]

Aasman ko humne apne zoar se banaya hai aur hum iski qudrat rakhte hain

[51:48]

Zameen ko humne bichaya hai aur hum badey acchey hamwar(Smoothers/ spread) karne waley hain

[51:49]

Aur har cheez ke humne jodey banaye hain, shayad ke tum ussey sabaq lo

[51:50]

To daudo Allah ki taraf , main tumahre liye us ki taraf se saaf saaf khabardar karne wala hoon

[51:51]

Aur na banao Allah ke saath koi dusra mabood. Main tumahre liye uski taraf se saaf saaf khabardar karne wala hoon

[51:52]

Yunhi hota raha hai, inse pehle ki qaumon ke paas bhi koi Rasool aisa nahin aaya jisey unhon ne yeh na kaha ho ke yeh saahir (sorcerer) hai ya majnoon(deewana)

[51:53]

Kya in sab ne apas mein ispar koi samjhauta karliya hai? Nahin, balke yeh sab sarkash log hain

[51:54]

Pas aey Nabi, inse rukh pher lo, tumpar kuch malamat nahin

[51:55]

Albatta nasihat karte raho, kyunke nasihat imaan laney walon ke liye nafeh(faiyda-mand) hai

[51:56]

Maine Jinn aur Insano ko iske siwa kisi kaam ke liye paida nahin kiya hai ke woh meri bandagi karein

[51:57]

Main unsey koi rizq nahin chahta aur na yeh chahta hoon ke woh mujhey khilayein

[51:58]

Allah to khud hi Razzak hai, badi quwwat wala aur zabardast

[51:59]

Pas jin logon ne zulm kiya hai unke hissey ka bhi waisa hi azaab tayyar hai jaisa inhi jaise logon ko unke hissey ka mil chuka hai, iske liye yeh log jaldi na machayein

[51:60]

Aakhir ko tabahi hai kufr karne walon ke liye us roz jiska inhein khauff dilaya jaa raha hai

Surah 052: At-Tur (The Mountain)

[52:1]

Kasam hai Tur (Mount) ki

[52:2]

Aur ek aisi khuli kitaab ki

[52:3]

Jo raqeeq jild(fine parchment) mein likkhi hui hai

[52:4]

Aur aabaad (much-frequented) ghar ki

[52:5]

Aur unchi chatt (canopy) ki

[52:6]

Aur maujzan samandar (swelling sea) ki

[52:7]

Ke tere Rubb ka azaab zaroor waqeh honay wala hai

[52:8]

Jisey koi dafa karne wala nahin

[52:9]

Woh us roz waqeh hoga jab aasmaan buri tarah dagmagayega

[52:10]

Aur pahad udey udey phirenge

[52:11]

Tabahi hai us roz un jhutlane walon ke liye

[52:12]

Jo aaj khel ke taur par apni hujjat baaziyon mein lagey huey hain

[52:13]

Jis din unhein dhakke maar maar kar naar-e-jahannum (fire of hell) ki taraf le chala jayega

[52:14]

Us waqt unse kaha jayega ke “ yeh wahi aag hai jisey tum jhutlaya karte thay

[52:15]

Ab batao yeh jaadu hai ya tumhein soojh nahin raha hai

[52:16]

Jao ab jhulso iske andar, tum khwa sabr karo ya na karo, tumhare liye yaksan hai, tumhein waisa hi badla diya ja raha hai jaise tum amal kar rahey thay

[52:17]

Muttaqi log wahan baagon (gardens) aur niyamaton mein hongey

[52:18]

Lutf le rahe hongey un cheezon se jo unka Rubb unhein dega, aur unka Rubb unhein dozakh ke azaab se bacha lega

[52:19]

(Unse kaha jayega) khao aur peo mazey se apne un aamaal ke siley mein jo tum karte rahey ho

[52:20]

Woh aamne saamne bichey huey takhaton(thrones) par takiye(couches) lagaye baithey hongey aur hum khoobsurat aankhon waali hoorein unse biyah (marry) denge

[52:21]

Jo log imaan laaye hain aur unki aulad bhi kisi darja-e-imaan mein unke naksh-e-qadam par chali hai unki us aulad ko bhi hun (jannat mein) unke saath mila denge aur unke amaal mein koi ghaata(loss) unko na denge. Har shaks apne kasb ke aevaz rehan hai.( Every person is pledged to what he did)

[52:22]

Hum unko har tarah ke phal (fruits) aur gosht , jis cheez ko bhi unka ji chahega khoob diye chale jayenge

[52:23]

Wahan woh ek dusre se jaam-e-sharaab lapak lapak kar le rahey hongey jis mein na yawa-goyi (ill speech) hogi na bad-kirdari

[52:24]
